Full description
Embark on an unforgettable day trip from Marrakech to the stunning Ait Benhaddou and Ouarzazate, two of Morocco's most iconic destinations, traveling through the breathtaking Tichka Pass.

Your adventure begins with a scenic drive through the High Atlas Mountains, where you will ascend to the Tichka Pass, the highest point of the road at an impressive 2,260 meters (7,410 feet) above sea level. This mountain pass offers panoramic views of the rugged terrain and picturesque valleys, with the opportunity to see traditional Berber villages nestled along the way. Ait Benhaddou has also served as the backdrop for many famous films and TV series, including Gladiator, Game of Thrones, and The Mummy. Explore the winding alleys, fortified walls, and the iconic hilltop kasbah for stunning views of the surrounding desert landscape. Your guide will share fascinating historical insights into the strategic importance of Ait Benhaddou as a trading post along the ancient caravan routes.
Next, head to Ouarzazate, often referred to as the "Gateway to the Sahara," and home to the famous Atlas Film Studios. Here, you’ll take a guided tour through one of the world’s largest film studios, where blockbuster movies like Lawrence of Arabia, The Gladiator, and The Prince of Persia were filmed. Explore the elaborate sets, including ancient Egyptian temples, medieval castles, and desert landscapes, and learn about the history of filmmaking in Morocco.

Throughout the day, enjoy a delicious traditional Moroccan lunch at a local restaurant, where you’ll be treated to classic dishes such as tagine and couscous, offering a taste of the region’s rich culinary heritage.

Embark on a popular and moderate day hike just outside of Marrakesh, ascending and descending almost 900m. Take in panoramic views of the Imlil and Imnane Valleys from several points along the route.

After your early morning pickup from your hotel in the city, sit back and relax on the 64-kilometer ride towards the High Atlas Mountains. Arrive at the village of Imlil (1,740m), the starting point of your hike.

Head up the Tamatert Valley to the Tizi n'Tamatert pass (2,280m) via the Berber villages of Ait Souka and Tamatert. From the pass, head into the Moroccan pine forest and pick up a trail that leads to the summit of the mighty Adrar Talamrout (2,600m).

At the summit of Adrar Talamrout, take your time to marvel at the view of the Imenane Valley and the Berber villages of Amskere and Ikkiss sprawling beneath you, before beginning your descent back to Imlil. Enjoy a lunch break on your way down, and a relaxed drop off back in Marrakesh.
